extraction.text:
Prakash Gupta

Phone: 9926127111 Email: prakash_gupta1985@yahoo.com Location: Mumbai

Professional Summary Markets & Securities Services professional with 15+ years of experience across Fund Administration, Fund Accounting, Hedge Fund Operations, Middle Office, Global Custody, and Capital Markets. Experienced in Trade Capture, Trade Processing, Trade Lifecycle, Trade Enrichment, Trade Confirmation, Trade Settlement, NAV Calculation & Validation, Cash, Position & Securities Reconciliation, Corporate Actions, SmartStream TLM Premium, Data Migration, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and operational transformation. Proven expertise in reconciliation, operational controls, stakeholder management, process improvement, migration initiatives, and client transitions across BNP Paribas, JPMorgan Chase, State Street, SS&C GlobeOp, and State Street Syntel..

Core Competencies Markets & Securities Services: Fund Administration • Fund Accounting • Hedge Fund Accounting • Middle Office Operations • Global Custody • Capital Markets

Trade Operations: Trade Capture • Trade Processing • Trade Lifecycle • Trade Enrichment • Trade Confirmation • Trade Settlement • Corporate Actions • NAV Calculation & Validation

Reconciliation & Controls: Cash Reconciliation • Position Reconciliation • Securities Reconciliation • FX Reconciliation • Three-Way Reconciliation • STP Break Investigation • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) • Exception Management • Operational Controls

Migration & Transformation: SmartStream TLM Premium • Process Migration • Data Migration • User Acceptance Testing (UAT) • Governance Reporting • Audit Support

Tools & Technologies: SmartStream TLM Premium • Geneva • Go Rec • Bloomberg • DTC • Newton • Tran Hub • FTS • SQL • SWIFT MT/MX • Bulk Upload

ONSITE EXPERIENCE

Worked onsite in Paris, France (6 months) to understand client requirements, support

process transitions, and implement operational improvements.

Worked onsite in Singapore (3 months) to facilitate knowledge transfer, client engagement,

and operational transformation initiatives.

Professional Experience

BNP Paribas | Assistant Manager – Hedge Fund Reconciliation / Fund Accounting -Jun 2022 – Sep 2024

Managed end-to-end Fund Administration activities for Hedge Fund portfolios, ensuring timely



and accurate NAV production. Executed Trade Capture, Trade Processing, Trade Enrichment, Trade Confirmation, and Trade Settlement across multiple investment products.

Validated trades, Corporate Actions, income events, and investment transactions prior to NAV













calculation. Performed Cash, Position, Securities, and NAV Reconciliations while investigating reconciliation breaks and resolving exceptions within SLA. Processed and validated SWIFT MT/MX messages supporting settlement processing and operational reconciliation. Executed Bulk Upload of trade, settlement, and reconciliation data into operational platforms while ensuring data integrity. Conducted STP Break Investigation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to improve operational efficiency and reduce settlement exceptions. Collaborated with Middle Office, Custody, Fund Accounting, and Client Service teams to resolve trade and settlement issues. Led governance reporting, audit readiness, SLA reviews, MIS reporting, operational controls, and Business Continuity Planning (BCP)

JPMorgan Chase | Consultant – Hedge Fund Accounting- Jan 2021 – May 2022 • Performed daily Fund Administration and Fund Accounting activities for Hedge Fund portfolios. • Supported the complete Trade Lifecycle from Trade Capture through Trade Settlement. • Managed Trade Confirmation activities by validating trade details and resolving confirmation











exceptions. Performed Trade Enrichment by validating settlement instructions (SSI), security master data, and trade attributes. Processed SWIFT MT/MX payment messages supporting investment operations and settlement activities. Performed Cash, Position, Securities, and NAV Reconciliations while investigating operational exceptions. Coordinated with Middle Office, Custody, and Operations teams to ensure timely settlement and accurate NAV delivery. Supported month-end NAV production, audit deliverables, and regulatory reporting requirements.

State Street HCL | SME – Hedge Fund Accounting -Feb 2019 – Jan 2021

Worked extensively on SmartStream TLM Premium for reconciliation, exception management,















and operational monitoring. Supported Trade Processing, Trade Enrichment, and reconciliation activities across Hedge Fund operations. Performed Pre-upload Validation of reconciliation files, trade data, and settlement information prior to SmartStream TLM processing. Executed Bulk Upload of reconciliation rules, trade files, and operational data into SmartStream TLM. Processed and validated SWIFT MT/MX messages supporting payment reconciliation and settlement validation. Executed migration testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), reconciliation validation, and post- production verification. Investigated STP breaks and reconciliation exceptions while performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Collaborated with technology teams during SmartStream TLM implementation, migration, and production support.

SS&C GlobeOp | Hedge Fund Accounting -Jul 2014 – Jan 2019

Managed end-to-end Hedge Fund reconciliations covering Cash, Position, Three-Way, FX, and







Corporate Actions. Supported Fund Administration, Trade Processing, and operational controls for Hedge Fund clients. Coordinated offshore transition, client migration, and reconciliation platform implementation activities. Investigated reconciliation exceptions, settlement breaks, and payment discrepancies while ensuring timely resolution. Supported Bulk Upload of reconciliation and migration data during transition activities.

• Worked closely with onshore teams during migration, UAT, and knowledge transfer. • • Performed reconciliation using Geneva and Go Rec platforms for global investment portfolios. Supported operational improvements to enhance Straight Through Processing (STP).

State Street Syntel | Senior Associate -Jan 2011 – Jul 2014



•

• •

Supported Middle Office operations for derivatives, collateral management, and margin settlement. Performed daily trade validation, collateral reconciliation, and settlement monitoring activities. Coordinated with brokers, custodians, and counterparties to resolve collateral and settlement discrepancies. Investigated MTM differences and settlement exceptions through Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Prepared daily operational MIS, KPI reports, and client reporting packs. Supported collateral movements and exposure monitoring while ensuring adherence to operational controls.

IDBI Capital Market Services | Relationship Manager -Aug 2009 – Dec 2011 Processed customer trade orders and supported investment-related transactions.



Conducted company research and provided investment recommendations to clients. • Assisted customers with capital market products while ensuring regulatory compliance and quality service.

KEY PROJECTS





• •

Successfully migrated multiple reconciliation processes to SmartStream TLM Premium, including validation, testing, and post-production support. Led client transition and reconciliation migration projects covering Cash, Position, Three-Way, FX, and Corporate Actions. Supported Hedge Fund Accounting transition from Singapore to Mumbai. Participated in collateral margin process transition from Paris to Mumbai. Successfully migrated multiple client processes to Joint Venture (JV) Management, supporting end-to-end record-keeping activities

CERTIFICATIONS

AMFI Mutual Fund Certification • NCFM – Capital Market & Derivatives • BCSM (BSE)

EDUCATION

• Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) – Ranchi University (2005)

PGDM / MBA – Pillai Institute of Management Studies & Research (2009)
